column1: # Tier 2 — Citation-grounded eval set (~25 questions)
# Columns: question<TAB>source_id<TAB>expected_claim
# - source_id is the canonical identifier the agent must cite inline
#   (recall campaign #, ODI complaint #, investigation action #, or
#   TSB #). The scorer does case-insensitive substring + hyphen/space
#   normalisation against the answer.
# - expected_claim is the short factual statement the cited source
#   supports. The LLM judge compares the agent's answer's claim about
#   that source to expected_claim on a 1-5 scale.
# - Entries are env-neutral: the ids should be real NHTSA ids stable
#   across dev/acc/prd.
